title: Creating a King's Field-inspired game with Opus 5.5
author: QuadrupedGaming
selftext:
I've been working with Opus 5.5 over the last few weeks to create a King's Field-inspired game that I'm calling Miasma. Amazed at what it can do! I started with storyboarding ideas, systems, and general game vibes. The graphics are made in BlockBench, using Godot as the game engine. From there, it has been weeks of iterative refinement! I have Claude create an artifact dashboard of all items that I need to review, and then provide it all as feedback for refining. The artifact dashboard specifically has been incredibly useful in really fine-tuning systems like combat.

With this method, I've been able to put together about 6 hours worth of gameplay, and I'm hoping to release it on Steam sometime next year. Let me know what you think! I would also love playtesters if anyone is interested.
